messages:
maya: heads-up — discovered a bunch of confusing auth conventions in the onboarding sample app. it reads REDWOOD_API_KEY, the README mentions REDWOOD_KEY, and the cli sample uses RW_TOKEN. new users are getting 401s and giving up 😕

aleks: ugh. did this come from copy-pasted examples across languages?

maya: yeah, looks like js/py/rust samples were forked ages ago and diverged. also the SDK retry behavior is odd — if a 401 happens it retries with the same cached key instead of surfacing a clear error.

sam: can you paste the snippet? maybe we unify to REDWOOD_API_KEY and add fallback to RW_TOKEN for backward compat.

maya: pasted —
```
const key = process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY || process.env.RW_TOKEN;
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: key });
```

jun: fallback is fine but we should log a warning on startup if RW_TOKEN is present and REDWOOD_API_KEY is missing. helps admins see drift.

aleks: agree. we should also update the SDK to treat 401 as non-retriable for auth errors and expose an `onAuthFailure` hook for apps to prompt rotation. right now it retries five times which just delays failure.

sam: +1. small proposal: 1) standard env var REDWOOD_API_KEY, 2) fallback RW_TOKEN for 6 months, 3) warn on fallback, 4) SDK: 401 => no token retry, emit event, and surface an error code `AUTH_EXPIRED`.

maya: sounds good. also want a one-page cheat-sheet in onboarding: env var names, precedence, how to rotate keys locally (short commands), and troubleshooting for 401 vs rate-limit. new hires hit this during dojo.

jun: i can draft the cheat-sheet. propose adding a lightweight cred-lint (pre-commit) rule that flags use of RW_TOKEN in new samples. cred-lint-bot can auto-comment PRs.

cred-lint-bot: flagged 3 files in the PR: samples/node/app.js, samples/python/app.py, examples/local-dev.md — recommended replacement: REDWOOD_API_KEY.

aleks: perfect. maya — can you open a meta-issue listing affected sample apps? we can assign follow-ups: SDK change, docs cheat-sheet, samples fix, cred-lint rule.

maya: opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/dev/issues/4123 — added checklist. assigning SDK retry change to @aleks, cheat-sheet to @jun, samples cleanup to @sam.

sam: i'll queue the sample fixes as a single PR so it's consistent across langs. will include a tiny note about rotation: `rw keys rotate --local` example and how to update env.

jun: once cheat-sheet is ready i'll post it in #onboarding and link it from the getting-started guide.

aleks: i'll scope the SDK change — want to avoid breaking existing infra so will gate behind minor version and opt-in via `auth: { strictAuthErrors: true }` config. default will be to emit `AUTH_EXPIRED` error on 401 and skip token retry.

maya: awesome. thanks all. smaller ask — could we also add a small unit test that simulates a token refresh cycle and ensures we don't retry on 401? saves another flurry of bugs.

aleks: yes, adding tests. i'll tag the PRs here when ready. :thumbsup:

maya: cheers — will follow up after PRs land to update the dojo script.
